title: Substring with Concatenation of All Words Problem

content.problemStatement:
You receive a string `s` and an array of strings `words`. All the strings of `words` are of **the same length**.

A **concatenated string** is a string that exactly includes all the strings of any permutation of `words` concatenated.

* As an example, if `words = ["ab","cd","ef"]`, then `"abcdef"`, `"abefcd"`, `"cdabef"`, `"cdefab"`, `"efabcd"`, and `"efcdab"` are all concatenated strings. `"acdbef"` is not a concatenated string because it is not the concatenation of any permutation of `words`.

The task is to output an array of *the starting indices* of all the concatenated substrings in `s`. You can output the answer in **any order**.
constraints: s and words[i] consist of lowercase English letters.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]
